approvers: Just me; my partner and the developer client if it is a cost on their job
reason: We have never paid for this and my margin on small jobs is thin. If the coating marks a frame or glass when it comes off and the manufacturer excludes it, I'm the one paying, and I can't see a client agreeing to an extra 19 euro per m2.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and nothing here says ACHV carries that risk. Also 50% deposit up front and a 150 m2 minimum is a lot for a two-person firm.
instead: Cardboard, tape and cheap protection film, and my own lads cleaning the glass before handover. I'd absorb the odd scratch.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that ACHV or its insurer pays for any damage to frames or glass from the coating or its removal, plus a Maltese contractor I know who used it on a similar job and a client willing to pay for it.
